records.clean_Japanese: 燃えるように輝く赤色の宝石。
records.source_meaning: A red gemstone that shines as if it were on fire.
records.localization_note: Retain the concise description and the visual comparison to fire.
records.english: A fiery red gemstone.
records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: Promotional relic catalogue description below its runtime-initialized title.

records.clean_Japanese: 古代文字が刻まれた短剣。破邪の効果があり退魔の儀式に使ったといわれる。
records.current_English:
A dagger with ancient writing, used
  in rites to ward off evil.
prior_private_rows: A dagger with ancient writing, used in rites to
records.source_meaning: A dagger with ancient writing engraved on it. It has the power to drive away evil and was said to be used in exorcism rites.
records.localization_note: Restore both the reputed power and the ritual use.
records.english: A dagger engraved with ancient writing. It's said to ward off evil and to have been used in rites of exorcism.
records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: Promotional relic catalogue description below its runtime-initialized title.

records.clean_Japanese: 蛇紋の石仮面２匹の蛇が浮き彫りにされている石の仮面。古代の儀式で神官が使ったといわれる。
records.current_English:
A stone mask bearing two carved
  serpents, used by ancient priests.
prior_private_rows: A stone mask bearing two carved serpents, used
records.source_meaning: A stone mask with two serpents in relief, said to have been used by priests in ancient rituals.
records.localization_note: Restore the relief work and the ritual context. Keep the claim qualified.
records.english: A stone mask with two serpents carved in relief. Ancient priests are said to have used it in rituals.
records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: Promotional relic catalogue description below its runtime-initialized title.

records.clean_Japanese: 六条の星が入った紅水晶。透明感とくっきりとした星の形はまれに見る逸品。
records.current_English:
A crimson crystal with a rare,
  clear six-rayed star.
prior_private_rows: A crimson crystal with a rare, clear six-rayed
records.source_meaning: Rose quartz with a six-rayed star. Its transparency and the sharply defined star make it an unusually fine specimen.
records.localization_note: Keep the material and explain what makes this specimen rare.
records.english: Rose quartz with a six-rayed star. Its clarity and the sharpness of the star make it a rare specimen.
records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: Promotional relic catalogue description below its runtime-initialized title.

records.clean_Japanese: 金剛石が入ったファントムクリスタル。水晶が再度成長したという珍しい品。集中力を高める効果があるといわれる。
records.current_English:
A diamond-bearing phantom crystal
  said to improve concentration.
prior_private_rows: A diamond-bearing phantom crystal said to
records.source_meaning: An uncommon phantom crystal containing a diamond, formed when the quartz grew again. It is said to improve concentration.
records.localization_note: Restore the second growth and retain the reported effect on concentration.
records.english: A rare phantom crystal with a diamond inside, said to have grown again. It's also said to improve concentration.
records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: Promotional relic catalogue description below its runtime-initialized title.

records.clean_Japanese: 東方の小さな島国の宝刀。触れていないものすら切れるというほどの鋭さを持つ。
records.current_English:
A treasured blade from an eastern
  island, sharp enough to cut afar.
prior_private_rows: A treasured blade from an eastern island, sharp
records.source_meaning: A treasured sword from a small eastern island nation. Its legendary sharpness is such that it can cut even what it does not touch.
records.localization_note: Keep the island nation and the supernatural claim without recasting it as ordinary range.
records.english: A treasured sword from a small island nation in the East. It's said to be sharp enough to cut without touching.
records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: Promotional relic catalogue description below its runtime-initialized title.

records.clean_Japanese: 歌声で船を難破させるセイレーンを模した船首像。なぜモチーフにされたのかは不明。
records.current_English:
A siren figurehead said to wreck
  ships with its song.
prior_private_rows: A siren figurehead said to wreck ships with its
records.source_meaning: A figurehead based on a siren whose singing wrecks ships. It is unknown why that likeness was chosen.
records.localization_note: Keep the shipwrecks part of the siren legend and restore the unexplained choice of design.
records.english: A figurehead of a siren whose song wrecks ships. No one knows why a siren was chosen.
records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: Promotional relic catalogue description below its runtime-initialized title.

records.clean_Japanese: 複雑にねじれたツノ。本当に竜のツノかどうかは不明。万病に効くといわれる。
records.current_English:
A twisted horn of uncertain origin,
  said to cure every illness.
prior_private_rows: A twisted horn of uncertain origin, said to
records.source_meaning: An intricately twisted horn. Whether it is truly a dragon’s horn is unknown. It is said to cure every illness.
records.localization_note: Name the disputed origin explicitly and keep the cure attributed to the in-game tradition.
records.english: A tightly twisted horn. No one knows if it really came from a dragon, but it's said to cure every illness.
records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: Promotional relic catalogue description below its runtime-initialized title.

records.clean_Japanese: 女神の姿が描かれた、偉大なる王の盾。船として使われたとの伝説もある。船乗りがお守りにしたいと憧れる品。
records.current_English:
A great king's shield bearing a
  goddess, prized by sailors.
prior_private_rows: A great king's shield bearing a goddess, prized
records.source_meaning: A great king’s shield depicting a goddess. According to legend it was used as a ship. Sailors long to have it as a talisman.
records.localization_note: Restore both the story of its use as a ship and what makes sailors seek it.
records.english: A great king's shield bearing a goddess. Legend says it served as a ship. Sailors long to have it as a good-luck charm.
records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: Promotional relic catalogue description below its runtime-initialized title.

records.clean_Japanese: 巨大な赤い槍。破邪の力があり、持つ者をあらゆる悪から守るといわれる。
records.current_English:
A giant red spear said to ward off
  evil and protect its bearer.
prior_private_rows: A giant red spear said to ward off evil and
records.source_meaning: A huge red spear with the power to ward off evil, said to protect whoever carries it against every kind of evil.
records.localization_note: Retain the direct description and the qualified protective power.
records.english: A giant red spear said to ward off evil and protect its bearer.
records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: Promotional relic catalogue description below its runtime-initialized title.
